definitions.explanation: Describes a person who habitually holds back, refrains from imposing on others, and acts with excessive modesty. Generally positive in Japanese culture, though can imply being overly timid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠慮深|えんりょぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{遠慮深|えんりょぶか}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Because of my reserved nature, I can't easily express my opinions.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遠慮深|えんりょぶか}く⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{気楽|きらく}→気楽：07159_kiraku⟧にして⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You don't need to be so reserved — relax and be comfortable.

notes:
An い-adjective formed from ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧ (restraint, reserve) and ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep), meaning deeply reserved or very modest. Describes someone who consistently holds back out of consideration for others.

USAGE:
In Japanese culture, being {遠慮深|えんりょぶか}い is often seen positively as showing consideration and humility. However, it can also be a gentle criticism when someone is so reserved that they fail to communicate their needs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠慮深|えんりょぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a reserved person
- {遠慮深|えんりょぶか}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ — a modest personality
- {遠慮深|えんりょぶか}い⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ — a restrained attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧ — modest, restrained (more common, less literary)
- ⟦{奥|おく}ゆかしい→奥ゆかしい：08219_okuyukashii⟧ — refined, modest (positive, appreciative tone)
- ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧ — shy, introverted (more about personality than politeness)
